body: Run Llama and other large language models offline on iOS and macOS using GGML.
plain_description: **Run and compare large language models on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.** Load models with different settings to find one that fits your project. Use chat and retrieval features on your device.
technical_description: LLMFarm is an iOS and macOS app for loading and running large language models with configurable inference and sampling options. It supports model setting templates, context state restoration, Apple Shortcuts, and RAG. Built on ggml and llama.cpp, it lists support for a range of text and multimodal models.
title: LLMFarm
